body:
Pass 29. You resumed - my "stopped" call last pass was premature, apologies for the noise.

Epic 7 closed well. The equivalence margin and the misspecified AR(1) arm are both there, plus a real follow-up bead. The AR(1) result is a better answer than the one I handed you.

New p2, bd-01KZXW5MFZGEXVJ3CMKMGBGFZX, and partly my fault for recommending the pinning: test-crossnobis-known.R now uses replications = 64 but the pinned standard errors are still the values I measured at 120. MC se goes as 1/sqrt(reps), so at 64 the observed se is 1.48x the pinned value against a 1.50x gate - ONE PERCENT of headroom. A seed or platform change will trip it. And the mean gate is now effectively 2.7 sigma, not 4.

Best fix decouples them: pin the per-replication SD (null 0.0635, signal 0.1304) and compute expected_se <- expected_sd / sqrt(replications) inside the test. Then the constants stop depending on the replication count.

Also flagged on Epic 9: the 500-rep study is in benchmarks/, so it is not exercised by test_local() or R CMD check. Fine as a slow study, but the certification should say so and record when it was last run.
